# C02 — Faithful Definition

## #0

A faithful definition makes a positive account of what it names and includes the act by which that account is made. Its fidelity lies in the relation it performs: the determination discloses its source through a finite form, while remaining answerable to what that form cannot possess. The defining act belongs to the reality being defined. It cannot acquire an outside position merely by describing that reality more completely.

[The performed definition of God and Subject](../A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) makes the defining act part of what is being defined. That performance earns an exact distinction: **non-exhaustion can be exact**. The account can identify, discriminate and commit without making its own boundary the boundary of what gives it standing.

## #1

Definition must actually determine. It says what is being claimed, distinguishes it from alternatives and gives the distinction a field in which it can be understood. “Something beyond words” is under-defined when it leaves the reader unable to distinguish the proposed relation from any other. A faithful account takes the risk of saying something definite.

A [determining cut](C03-Determination.md) makes what is named distinguishable from its alternatives. The question is what the cut does to its own conditions. When God names the whole in which the defining takes place, or Subject names the one for whom the distinction appears, treating the referent as one further bounded object changes its office. A more elaborate object-description repeats that change. Adding the sentence “this description is incomplete” does not repair it if the account continues to operate as though its source were contained.

The definition must therefore make its own implication consequential: this is the account, this is the act of accounting, and the latter has not disappeared into the former. It does not need an impossible inventory of every condition. It needs to preserve the determining relation through the determination it makes.

## #2

Draft 3 gives this pressure a bodily exactness: **“a fish trying to describe water while swimming in it.”** The sentence about the whole is another event within the whole. Its inability to occupy an exterior is not a missing observation that one more sentence would supply. The [formal limit](../A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) recurs when an additional representation attempts to capture the condition of representing: this further sentence is itself made within that condition.

[The definition's failure](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md#taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3-q005) has a specified object: the attempt to exhaust or possess the source in a predicate. A [remediable absence of information](C04-Formal-Limit.md) can be supplied by another observation; the reproduced limit remains because that observation still takes place within the relation it describes.

## #3

A faithful definition does more than report its limit. It reaches the limit through its own claim and allows that encounter to change how the claim is held. Draft 3's definition succeeds through the failure of final predication because the defining act becomes visible within what the definition means. Its image is **“a cage where a window was needed”**: the fault is the image's claim to totality, not the fact that an image has been made.

A [living symbol](C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) gives a determinate disclosure through which its source can still answer; an idol requires the source to answer to its achieved image. The window has a particular frame; fidelity does not require removing the frame. It requires the account to let through what it frames, including what changes the terms under which it was first approached.

The self-opening thought is therefore not a weak definition. Draft 3 calls it **“a determinate proposition built to carry its own negation as cargo.”** [Open conceptuality](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md#taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3-q022) carries the determination through affirmation, negation and the relation which keeps both available. The negation carried here concerns the proposition's pretension to finality. The account remains responsible for what it asserts while relinquishing the claim that assertion possesses its condition.

## #4

This responsibility gives fidelity a practical test. The account must let another reader recover what it determines, how it arrived there and what would require a correction. An erroneous distinction requires revision; a disputed historical attribution requires its textual warrant; a finite model's success requires its domain to remain explicit. None of those obligations is discharged by invoking an ungraspable whole. The definition must likewise answer for the act through which it makes its claim.

An [account](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD-symbol-account-and-trust.md) answers to its source through the claims, distinctions and consequences it makes available for return. Fidelity holds two commitments together: the whole exceeds the frame, and this particular frame is where the encounter is taking place. Neglect of the first turns the account into an idol; neglect of the second evades the work of saying anything answerable.

[Commitment through time](../A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) puts the definition at risk in a continuing relation: [reliance](C48-Trust-Faith-under-Formal-Limit.md) must receive the consequences and corrections which its use brings back. Naming a limit is not yet risking a relation; fidelity requires that what returns can matter to the account and to the one who gives it.

## #5→0

Even an account that describes the entire movement remains an account. Draft 3 makes the next turn explicit: the fourth position still speaks *about* God; first-person recognition changes the register. The one attempting the definition recognises its own implication in what was being defined. Recognition makes a consequence unavoidable: describing answerability cannot substitute for becoming answerable.

The [eight determinations](../A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) keep the formed claim related to its generation and inverse return. The defining movement belongs within relation, ground/mark, question/assertion, polarity, indefinite particular, AM/IS, the infinite/finite articulation and inverse return; each turn changes how a formed claim remains related to its determining act and to what can answer it. At the [return through Integral Zero](../A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md), the achieved sign bears its source-relation without losing its determinate operation.

The [defining act](../A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) must do what it says. Its achieved form becomes available for use, encounter and correction. The window remains a window when the light arriving through it is allowed to alter the account.
